lessons.title: Experimental design
lessons.objective: Build championship-level understanding of experimental design and apply it accurately to unfamiliar problems.
lessons.core_teaching_content: Advanced science questions require integration of experiment design, physics, chemistry, biology and Earth or space systems. Identify measurable variables, the relevant principle and evidence before calculating or concluding. Focus specifically on experimental design. Identify the core ideas, common traps, evidence or procedure needed to justify an answer, and the verification step that protects against careless errors. Practise moving from recognition to application: identify the task, select a method, execute it carefully, and check the result against all constraints. Record errors by cause so revision targets the underlying weakness.
examples: A National Science Championship problem on experimental design should begin by identifying the exact clue or condition that determines the method.
Create a new experimental design problem with a plausible distractor and explain why the correct solution satisfies every condition.
lessons.practical_activity: Complete a focused National Science Championship activity on experimental design using a worked problem, comparison table, diagram, passage or data set as appropriate.
lessons.guided_practice: Work through three scaffolded tasks on experimental design: model the first, prompt the second, and require an independent solution to the third with explicit justification.
independent_practice: Solve three unfamiliar experimental design questions without viewing solutions.
Create and solve one new challenge using the lesson principle.
Analyse one error and state the rule that would prevent it next time.
lessons.assessment_checkpoint: Complete an eight-item National Science Championship checkpoint on experimental design; target at least six correct and justify every uncertain answer.
lessons.student_task: Produce one finished championship task demonstrating experimental design and show the reasoning or evidence used.
lessons.tutor_guidance: Coach for precise definitions, explicit reasoning and independent verification. Do not replace productive struggle with immediate answers. Suitable for self-learning.
lessons.reflection_completion: Record one strength, one recurring error and one measurable action for improving experimental design.
lessons.daily_flow: Learn → Worked Example → Guided Challenge → Independent Practice → Check → Reflect
